android_packages.scope: All four ABIs: exact APK-entry/stripped-library identity, ELF class/machine and 16KiB LOAD alignment. This does not inspect all-ABI shader payloads; supported shader inspection is separately ARM64-only.

limits: Host compilation/package inspection only. No GPU presentation, Android installation, touch/lifecycle, listening, vibration or performance acceptance.
